Overall, it was good, but the vet didn't tell us directly what was wrong with our dog. They kept doing tests to drive up the treatment costs. If they couldn't find something, they'd test something else. In reality, our dog had an epileptic seizure and was bitten by a poisonous animal. Judging from the medication, they had anticonvulsants, an anti-seizure drug (gabapectin), and a fat-boosting supplement that said "medication for dementia" on the packaging, which shocked us. But after doing some research, we felt more at ease.
We took our dog for one night (admitted at 2 AM) and picked him up in the afternoon. The cost was over 5,000 baht. We think it's too expensive, and we can buy Vetplus and the supplement cheaper elsewhere. We definitely won't go back there.😔😔😔
